# LeskoHelp Pro

> LeskoHelp Pro is Matthew Lesko's grant coaching community for freelancers, small businesses, and nonprofits. Members get daily live grant coaching classes, personalized AI grant-match reports, the Lesko AI researcher, and weekly live sessions with Matthew Lesko himself.

Matthew Lesko has cataloged U.S. government and foundation funding programs for 50 years. The community's database covers federal, state, local, and private-foundation grants — far beyond Grants.gov.

## What members get

- Daily live coaching classes (Zoom, every weekday; Thursday Drop-In Clinic runs all day, no booking required)
- Personalized AI grant reports: grants matched to your work, location, and eligibility in about five minutes
- The Lesko AI researcher: ask anything about funding your plans, in plain language
- Direct access to Matthew: weekly Matthew Lives where he answers questions on the spot

## Pricing

- 5-day trial: $1 (renews at $19.95/month) — https://www.leskohelp.com/business-trial
- 6-month plan: $14.99/month billed semi-annually ($89.95) — https://www.leskohelp.com/business-half-year
- Yearly plan: $12.49/month billed yearly ($149.95) — https://www.leskohelp.com/business-yearly
- 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans

## Frequently asked questions

- **Are these actually real grants? It feels too good.** Yes. Every program in our database is a real, government or foundation-administered grant. Matthew has been cataloging them for 50 years. The catch isn't that they don't exist. It's that they're scattered across thousands of agencies, foundations, and state programs that don't market themselves. Our job is to surface the ones you qualify for.
- **I'm a freelancer or a one-person business. Do grants even apply to me?** More than you'd expect. There are programs specifically for sole proprietors, individual artists, freelance researchers, women-owned businesses, veteran-owned businesses, rural entrepreneurs, and many other niches. The AI report is built to find the ones that match your specific situation, not just generic small-business programs.
- **How is this different from just searching Grants.gov myself?** Grants.gov is one source: the federal one. Most of the funding for small operators actually comes from state agencies, regional economic development offices, and private foundations that aren't on Grants.gov at all. Our database covers all of those, and the coaching helps you actually navigate the application, not just find it.
- **Will someone write my grant application for me?** No, and that's intentional. Grant writers cost $2,000–$10,000+ per application and can't fund themselves working on a freelance budget. We coach you through writing your own, with feedback at every step. Most members find that after one or two applications, they can do it themselves with confidence.
- **What if I'm too busy to attend live classes?** Classes run every weekday across multiple time zones, and most are recorded. Many members never attend live. They post in the Questions Channel and get replies within hours. The community works asynchronously too.
- **Is this U.S. only?** The grant database is U.S.-focused (federal, state, local, U.S. foundations). The coaching and frameworks apply more broadly, but most of the specific programs require U.S. eligibility.
- **What's the refund policy?** 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans. If you join, attend a few classes, generate a report, and decide it's not for you, we refund you. No forms, no friction.
